meta.title: 哈1 · 第22～28讲 动词时态专题
meta.subtitle: 八种时态手册：总览 → 一般现在/过去/将来 → 现在进行 → 过去将来/过去进行 → 现在完成（含延续转换）→ 过去完成 → 标志词与固定句型 → 综合坑（if 双身份 / 宾从三律 / raise·rise 等）。绑定马林；作业卷原题只在「你错过的」里，热身题全部自含。

nodes.title: ① 八种时态总览——一张对照表先装进脑子
nodes.explain:
马林你好！哈一第 22～28 讲其实在讲同一件事：谓语动词怎么告诉别人「这件事发生在什么时间、以什么方式」。英语里常用的就是下面这八种时态。先把这张总表背熟，后面每一关都是在往格子里填细节。

八种时态 · 构成 + 一句话感觉
时态构成一句话感觉典型标志
一般现在时do / does习惯、真理、现在状态always / every day / on Sundays
一般过去时did过去某时做了（已翻篇）yesterday / ago / last week / in 2015
一般将来时will do / be going to do将来要发生tomorrow / next week / in two days / soon
过去将来时would do / was(were) going to do站在过去看将来（常在 said/told 后）said / told / hoped + the next day
现在进行时am/is/are + doing此刻/这段时间正在做now / Look! / Listen! / these days
过去进行时was/were + doing过去某时正在做（电影画面）at 8 last night / this time yesterday / when…
现在完成时have/has + done过去→现在的桥梁（影响/持续/经历）since / for / already / yet / ever / so far
过去完成时had + done过去的过去（更早那一下）by the time / by the end of last… / before + 过去
自学路线先读本关总表 → 按 ②～⑪ 一关一关学 → 最后进 ⑫ 综合坑。每关下面有「热身自测」：先想再点开答案。作业卷原题只出现在「你错过的」里，不会剧透作业卷。
马林特别提醒你 26～28 讲掉分最重的是现在完成时锚点和瞬间动词→延续。总表里这两格要额外多看两眼，对应后面第 ⑧、⑨ 关。
nodes.qs_label: 热身：认时态（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: 看到 since 2018 / for three years / already，优先想到哪种时态？
general_qs.explain: 这些都是「算到现在」的标志：since/for 管持续，already 管已完成影响现在。

general_qs.stem: 主句是 He said…，从句里谈「第二天要去」，从句用什么？
general_qs.answer: 过去将来时 would do / was going to do
general_qs.explain: 站在过去看将来：said 把 will 往后推一级 → would。

general_qs.stem: 「昨天下午四点我正在写作业」——was writing 属于哪种时态？
general_qs.explain: 过去某一点/某一段正在进行的动作 = 过去进行时。

nodes.title: ② 一般现在时——习惯、真理、现在状态
nodes.explain:
一般现在时说的是：经常这样 / 现在就是这样 / 客观永远这样。不是「正在做」（那是进行时），也不是「做过了」（那是过去/完成）。

构成：主语 + do/does（实义动词）
　　　主语 + am/is/are（be 动词）
三单：he/she/it → 动词 +s/+es；否定用 doesn’t + 原形；疑问 Does…?
用法速查
用法例句
现在状态The soup tastes good.
习惯 / 经常性动作I often exercise at the park.
性格 / 能力I am rather outgoing.
客观真理 / 自然现象The sun rises in the east.
标志词

· 频度副词：always / usually / often / sometimes / seldom / hardly / never
· 频度短语：once a year / twice a month / three times a day
· 其他：every day/week…, on Wednesdays, at weekends

别被 always 骗I always eat apples.（现在的习惯）≠ I always ate apples when I was in France.（过去那段时间的习惯 → 过去时）。标志词要看上下文！
第三人称单数拼写
类别方法例
一般情况+shelp→helps, stay→stays
s/x/ch/sh/o 结尾+eswatch→watches, go→goes
辅音+y去 y +iesstudy→studies, fly→flies
特殊—have→has, do→does, be→is

wrong_qs.note: 首次卷：teaches us（三单 + 宾格）
通常习惯 → has（三单）

general_qs.stem: Amy usually ________ (have) sports on Sunday mornings.
general_qs.explain: usually = 习惯 → 一般现在；Amy 三单 → has（不是 have）。

general_qs.stem: The earth ________ (go) around the sun.
general_qs.explain: 客观真理 → 一般现在；go 以 o 结尾 → goes。

general_qs.stem: She ________ (not / watch) TV every night.
general_qs.explain: 否定：doesn’t + 原形。注意 watch 不要再加 -es。

general_qs.stem:
Miss Gu is our English teacher. She ________ ________ English.
A. teaches, our  B. teaches, us  C. teachs, our  D. teachs, us
general_qs.explain: she → teaches（ch 结尾 +es，不是 teachs）；teach 后人称代词用宾格 us。

memory.front: 一般现在时的构成公式？三单形式要注意什么？
memory.back:
构成：主语 + do/does（实义动词）
　　　主语 + am/is/are（be 动词）
三单：he/she/it → 动词 +s/+es；否定用 doesn't + 原形；疑问 Does…?

nodes.title: ③ 一般过去时——过去档案（已翻篇）
nodes.explain:
一般过去时是「过去的档案柜」：某时做了、某段时间反复做过、当时是什么状态——和现在没有必然联系。有具体过去时间点（yesterday / ago / in 2015）几乎必选它。

构成：主语 + 动词过去式（did）
　　　主语 + was / were
否定：didn’t + 原形；疑问：Did … + 原形？
用法
用法例句
过去某时 / 某段的动作或状态I lived in Canada last year.
过去经常发生（常配 always/often + 过去语境）I always ate apples when I was in France.
叙述过去的故事Once upon a time, there was a king…
标志词

yesterday / the day before yesterday / last week / … ago / in 1990 / just now / once upon a time / at that time / in the old days

规则动词 -ed 拼写与读音
拼写例-ed 读音
一般 +edhelp→helped, play→played清辅音后 [t]；浊/元音后 [d]；t/d 后 [ɪd]
不发音 e 结尾 +dlive→lived, hope→hoped同上
辅音+y → iedstudy→studied[ɪd]
重读闭音节双写 +edstop→stopped, plan→planned[t]/[d]
和高危亲戚对比看到 yesterday / ago → 过去时；看到 yet / since / twice / 现在结果 → 完成时。详细辨析见第 ⑧ 关。

wrong_qs.note: watched 的 -ed 读 [t]（清辅音后）
when he was in Beijing → went（过去习惯）
Yesterday afternoon → stopped（双写 p）
when she was young → had

general_qs.stem: Tim always ________ (go) to work by bike when he was in Beijing.
general_qs.explain: when he was in Beijing 把整句钉在过去 → went（不是 goes）。

general_qs.stem: Yesterday afternoon, I ________ (stop) to help the old lady.
general_qs.explain: yesterday → 过去时；stop 重读闭音节 → 双写 p + ed。

general_qs.stem:
watched 的 -ed 读音是？
A. [t]  B. [d]  C. [ɪd]
general_qs.explain: watch 以清辅音 [tʃ] 结尾 → -ed 读 [t]。

general_qs.stem: —How many books ________ they ________ last summer? —Five.
general_qs.explain: last summer 是过去档期，问「当时借了几本」→ 一般过去 did borrow。

memory.front: 一般过去时的构成公式？否定和疑问怎么变？
memory.back:
构成：主语 + 动词过去式（did）
　　　主语 + was / were
否定：didn't + 原形；疑问：Did … + 原形？

nodes.title: ④ 一般将来时 + will vs be going to + 主将从现
nodes.explain:
一般将来时：将来某个时间要发生，或将来经常发生。

will + do　　／　　am/is/are going to + do
否定：won’t / am not going to …
疑问：Will you…? / Are you going to…?
will vs be going to
区别说明例句
事先计划be going to＝考虑过、打算好的I’m going to visit the museum this weekend.
临时决定will＝当下才决定Someone is knocking — I’ll answer it.
迹象预测有眼前证据 → be going toLook at the clouds — it’s going to rain.
纯粹意愿 / 承诺will 更常见I will help you.
标志词

tomorrow / the day after tomorrow / next week / in two days / in 2050 / in the future / soon

主将从现（超级高频）
口诀主句将来时（或情态 / 祈使），条件/时间从句用一般现在表将来，禁止 will。
引导词例句
if 如果I will stay at home if it rains tomorrow.
unless 除非He will be late unless he gets up early.
as long as 只要As long as you’re happy, I will be happy.
when / as soon as / until / before / afterI will call you when I arrive.
和「是否」的 if 别混这里的 if＝如果（条件句）。若 if＝是否（跟在 wonder/know/ask 后），从句该 will 就 will。详见第 ⑫ 关。

wrong_qs.note: 主将从现：will go … if it snows

general_qs.stem:
We ________ to play with snow if it ________ tomorrow.
A. will go, will snow  B. will go, snows  C. go, will snow  D. go, snows
general_qs.explain: if＝如果 → 主将从现：主句 will go，从句 snows（禁 will snow）。

general_qs.stem: Look at those dark clouds! It ________ (rain).
general_qs.explain: 眼前有迹象 → be going to（不是临时 will）。

general_qs.stem: —The phone is ringing. —OK, I ________ (answer) it.
general_qs.explain: 临时决定 → will。

general_qs.stem: He will be late for school unless he ________ (get) up early.
general_qs.explain: unless 条件从句 → 一般现在三单 gets（禁 will get）。

memory.front: 一般将来时的两种公式？各自的否定和疑问？
memory.back:
will + do　　／　　am/is/are going to + do
否定：won't / am not going to …
疑问：Will you…? / Are you going to…?

nodes.title: ⑤ 现在进行时 + 现在分词拼写
nodes.explain:
现在进行时：说话这一刻正在做，或当前这一阶段正在做（此刻未必正在）。少数表示来去的动词（come/go/leave/start）也可用进行时表「按计划即将」。

am / is / are + doing
否定：isn’t / aren’t + doing；疑问：Is/Are … doing?
用法
用法例句
说话瞬间正在做The students are listening to the teacher.
现阶段活动（未必此刻）We are making model planes these days.
计划好的近期将来（come/go/leave…）Your aunt is coming this afternoon.
标志词

now / right now / at this moment / at present / these days；以及句子以 Look! / Listen! 开头。

现在分词拼写（必背）
类别方法例
一般+inghelp→helping, study→studying
不发音 e 结尾去 e +ingwrite→writing, take→taking
重读闭音节 + 单辅音双写 +ingstop→stopping, run→running, sit→sitting, swim→swimming
ie 结尾变 y +ingdie→dying, lie→lying

wrong_qs.note: this afternoon 计划安排 → is coming
Look! → is dancing
now → are writing

general_qs.stem: Look! The little girl ________ (dance) to the music.
general_qs.explain: Look! 提示正在进行；主语 the little girl → is dancing。

general_qs.stem: Students ________ (write) their names on the board now.
general_qs.explain: now + 复数主语 → are writing（write 去 e +ing）。

general_qs.stem: Tom, your aunt ________ (come) this afternoon.
general_qs.explain: come 类动词用进行时表近期计划安排。

general_qs.stem: 写出下列现在分词：run / write / die / swim
general_qs.explain: run/swim 双写；write 去 e；die → dying。

memory.front: 现在进行时的构成公式？否定和疑问怎么变？
memory.back:
am / is / are + doing
否定：isn't / aren't + doing；疑问：Is/Are … doing?

nodes.title: ⑥ 过去将来时——站在过去看将来
nodes.explain:
对比：Mary will go to Canada.（现在的将来）→ Tom said that Mary would go to Canada.（过去的将来）。

would + do　　／　　was / were going to + do
常见栖息地：said / told / hoped / promised / was not sure + 宾语从句
用法
用法例句
宾语从句里（主句过去 → 从句回退）She said she would never give up.
过去的打算 / 计划He was going to return home.
条件/时间从句嵌进宾从时（主句过去）

原来的「主将从现」也要整体回退一级：

I will stay if it rains.
⟹ I said I would stay if it rained.
现在说法嵌进「I said…」之后
I will stay if it rains.I said I would stay if it rained.
He will be late unless he gets up early.I said he would be late unless he got up early.
I will call when I arrive.I said I would call when I arrived.
记忆主句过去 → 将来变 would，从句里的一般现在也变成一般过去。come/go 等仍可用 was/were coming 表过去的「计划将来」。

wrong_qs.note: said → would visit
hoped … the next Wednesday → was coming
were not sure whether → were going to grow
首次 47 分卷：said → would call

general_qs.stem: Miss Zhang said she ________ (visit) the Great Wall with me again.
general_qs.explain: said 过去 + 将来内容 → would visit。

general_qs.stem:
I hoped Tina ______ to my birthday party the next Wednesday.
A. to come  B. is coming  C. will come  D. was coming
general_qs.explain: hoped 过去 + the next Wednesday → 过去将来；come 可用 was coming。

general_qs.stem:
We were not sure whether they ______ more vegetables.
A. are going to grow  B. were going to grow  C. will grow  D. have grown
general_qs.explain: 主句 were not sure 过去 → 从句 were going to grow。

general_qs.stem:
把句子回退：I will stay at home if it rains tomorrow.
→ I said I ________ stay at home if it ________ the next day.
general_qs.explain: will→would，rains→rained；tomorrow 常改成 the next day。

memory.front: 过去将来时的两个公式？它常出现在哪类从句里？
memory.back:
would + do　　／　　was / were going to + do
常见栖息地：said / told / hoped / promised / was not sure + 宾语从句

nodes.title: ⑦ 过去进行时——过去正在放的电影
nodes.explain:
was / were + doing。时间轴画法：was doing 是一条横线，when 后的 did 是线上扎下的一根针。

锚点① when 模型：长动作（was doing）＋ when ＋ 瞬间动作（did）
　　　——「正……着，突然……」：I was taking a walk when I met him.
锚点② 过去某段/某点正进行：from 4:00 to 6:00 yesterday / at eight last night
锚点③ while 两线并行：While mum was washing, I was making a kite.
标志词

this time yesterday / at 6 o’clock this morning / then / at that moment / from…to… yesterday / at eight last night

和一般过去搭配when 后的瞬间动作用一般过去（rang / entered / saw）；长时间动作才用 was doing。不要两边都用 did，也不要两边都用 was doing（除非 while 两线）。

wrong_qs.note: when I entered → were making
When the bell rang（针）, Jenny was waiting（线）
at half past six yesterday → was having
were reading … when I saw you
While … was doing, I was making
首次 47 分卷：when I was taking a walk
was going … when the accident occurred
from 4:00 to 6:00 yesterday → was playing
when I got home → was sitting（sit 双写）

general_qs.stem: They ________ (make) a model ship when I entered the room.
general_qs.explain: entered 是针，make 是线 → were making。

general_qs.stem: I ________ (have) my breakfast at half past six yesterday morning.
general_qs.explain: 过去具体时间点 + 正在 → was having。

general_qs.stem:
What book ______ you ______ when I ______ you at four yesterday?
A. did, read, was seeing  B. did, read, saw  C. were, reading, saw  D. were, reading, was seeing
general_qs.explain: 四点正在读 → were reading；看见是瞬间 → saw。

general_qs.stem:
While mother ______ some washing, I ______ a kite for Kate.
A. did, made  B. was doing, made  C. was doing, was making  D. did, was making
general_qs.explain: while 两线并行 → 两边都用过去进行。

memory.front: 过去进行时的三个锚点句型是什么？
memory.back:
锚点① when 模型：长动作（was doing）＋ when ＋ 瞬间动作（did）
　　　——「正……着，突然……」：I was taking a walk when I met him.
锚点② 过去某段/某点正进行：from 4:00 to 6:00 yesterday / at eight last night
锚点③ while 两线并行：While mum was washing, I was making a kite.

nodes.title: ⑧ 现在完成时——过去和现在的桥梁（头号敌人）
nodes.explain:
现在完成时 have/has + done 不是「过去的事」，而是站在现在，回头看过去：要么影响到现在，要么持续到现在，要么算到现在的总账。

公式卡 · 锚点速查表（背这个）
句中看到这些信号用例句锚点
since + 过去时间点 / since 从句have/has doneSince we began..., our lives have changed
for + 时间段（至今还在算）have/has doneI have been here since five months ago
twice / three times（经历次数）have/has doneI have seen it twice
ever / never / yet / already / so farhave/has doneHave you ever visited...?
in recent years / these dayshave/has doneOnline shopping has become popular
后半句是现在的结果：so... / now... / Can you...?have/has doneI have lost my pen. Can you lend me yours?
It is the first / second time (that)...从句 have/has doneIt is the first time he has written a book
since 从句里面的动词一般过去时It is two years since I became a doctor
⚠️ 最后一行最容易反since 前半句用完成时，since 从句里的起点动作用过去时——「自从我成为医生（那一刻）已经两年了」，"成为"是过去的一瞬间。
高危辨析 · 完成时 vs 一般过去
一句话判断问「做没做 / 影响到现在」（现在算账）→ 完成时；问「过去某时做了什么、做了几件」（过去档案）→ 一般过去。
看到 yesterday / in 2015 / two days ago → 过去时；看到 yet / ever / since / twice 或现在的结果 → 完成时。

· for + 时间段；since + 时间点或过去时从句。
· already 多用于肯定；yet 多用于疑问/否定。
nodes.qs_label: 热身自测（换马甲，不剧透作业卷）

wrong_qs.note: 首次 47 分卷：since → have been
for a long time → has sat
since 从句里 → became（过去时）
twice + 影响现在 → has seen
现在的乱象 → has left
so 后是现在结果 → has lost
I have seen it twice
Can you lend… → have lost
ever + yet → Have visited
You can work… now → have fixed
Since we began… → have changed
It is the first time → has written
In recent years → has become

general_qs.stem: Mr. Wang ________ (teach) in this school since 2018.
general_qs.explain: since 2018 → 现在完成；Mr. Wang 三单 → has taught。

general_qs.stem: —________ you ever ________ (try) Sichuan food? —Yes, twice.
general_qs.explain: ever + 经历 → 现在完成；主语 you → Have tried。

general_qs.stem: Look! Somebody ________ (break) the window. The glass is everywhere.
general_qs.explain: 现在的结果（玻璃满地）→ has broken。

general_qs.stem: It is the third time she ________ (win) the first prize.
general_qs.explain: It is the … time → 从句现在完成 has won。

general_qs.stem: —How many books ________ you ________ (read) during the summer holiday? —Three.
general_qs.explain: during the summer holiday 是过去档期，问当时读了几本 → 一般过去（同完成 vs 过去辨析）。

nodes.title: ⑨ 瞬间动词不能牵手 for——延续性转换
nodes.explain:
完成时 + for/since 时间段 ⇒ 谓语必须能一直持续。borrow、leave、die、buy 这类「一秒就完成」的动词撑不起一段时间，必须换成对应的状态表达。

公式卡 · 瞬间 → 延续 转换表（必背）
瞬间动词（× for 时间段）延续表达（✓）中文
borrow 借keep借了 → 一直留着
buy 买have买了 → 一直拥有
leave 离开be away (from)离开了 → 一直不在
die 死be dead去世了 → 一直是故去状态
begin / startbe on开演了 → 一直进行
finish / endbe over结束了 → 一直是结束状态
join 加入be in / be a member of加入了 → 一直是成员
make / become friendsbe friends交了朋友 → 一直是朋友
openbe open开门了 → 一直营业
closebe closed关门了 → 一直关着
fall asleepbe asleep睡着了 → 一直睡着
catch a coldhave a cold感冒了 → 一直感冒

同义句转换套路：

主语 + 瞬间动词 + ... + ago（过去一次性动作）
⟹ 主语 + have/has + 延续表达 + ... + for + 时间段
过去完成也要延续for a few minutes 出现在过去完成里，同样不能用 had left，要用 had been away from。

wrong_qs.note: 首次 47 分卷：had been away from（过去完成也要延续）
have been friends（made/became × since）
borrow→keep：has kept … for two days
同 28·T12 模板
leave→be away from（from 不能丢）
die→has been dead

general_qs.stem:
His father died five years ago.（同义句）
His father ________ ________ ________ for five years.
general_qs.explain: die → be dead；完成时 + for → has been dead。

general_qs.stem:
Lily bought the bike two weeks ago.（同义句）
Lily ________ ________ the bike for two weeks.
general_qs.explain: buy → have；has had。

general_qs.stem:
They joined the club in 2023.（同义句）
They ________ ________ ________ the club for about three years.
general_qs.explain: join → be in / be a member of。

general_qs.stem:
The film began ten minutes ago.（同义句）
The film ________ ________ ________ for ten minutes.
general_qs.explain: begin → be on。

general_qs.stem:
Mr. Li left Tianjin three days ago.（同义句）
Mr. Li ________ ________ ________ ________ Tianjin for three days.
general_qs.explain: leave → be away from，from 不能丢。

memory.front: 瞬间动词不能牵手 for——怎么改写成延续性表达？
memory.back:
主语 + 瞬间动词 + ... + ago（过去一次性动作）
⟹ 主语 + have/has + 延续表达 + ... + for + 时间段

nodes.title: ⑩ 过去完成时——过去的过去
nodes.explain:
had + 过去分词。句中已有一个「过去的时间参照物」，某动作发生在它更早之前。

时间轴：[had done 更早] ────── [did 过去参照点] ────── 现在
锚点三兄弟（看到就选 had done）
锚点例
By the time + 过去时从句By the time I got up, Mum had cooked breakfast
by the end of + 过去时间by the end of last term → had studied
Before + 过去动作Before she came to China, she had heard about the Great Wall
判断口诀：句中两个过去动作，先发生的那个用 had done。

也可表「从过去某时持续到另一过去时」：The film had been on for 5 minutes when I got to the cinema.

wrong_qs.note: by the end of last term → had studied
By the time I got up → had cooked
By the time I was five → had read
Before she came → had heard

general_qs.stem: By the time the police arrived, the thief ________ (run) away.
general_qs.explain: arrived 是过去参照，逃跑更早 → had run。

general_qs.stem: When I got to the station, the train ________ (leave).
general_qs.explain: 到站时火车已经走了 → had left。

general_qs.stem: She ________ (learn) 2,000 English words by the end of last year.
general_qs.explain: by the end of last year → 过去完成。

general_qs.stem: Before we arrived at the cinema, the film ________ (begin).
general_qs.explain: before + 过去 → 更早用 had begun。

memory.front: 过去完成时和一般过去时在时间轴上是什么关系？
memory.back: 时间轴：[had done 更早] ────── [did 过去参照点] ────── 现在

nodes.title: ⑪ 看标志词 · 固定句型搭配（第27讲核心）
nodes.explain:
第 27 讲的核心技能：先圈标志词，再定时态。再加几组「看见句型就填时态」的固定搭配。

标志词速查总表
时态标志词
一般现在always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day, on Sundays
一般过去ago, yesterday, the day before yesterday, last week, just now
一般将来tomorrow, next week, in two days, soon, the day after tomorrow
现在完成already, yet, so far, up to now, for+段, since+点, over/in the past/last few years, recently
过去完成before + 过去, by + 过去, by the time + 过去从句
现在进行now, at the moment, these days, this week, at present, Look!, Listen!
过去进行at this time yesterday, at 8 last night, then, from…to… yesterday
过去将来said/told/hoped + the next day / the following week
固定句型
句型从句时态例
This/It is the first/second time that…现在完成This is the first time I have visited the Great Wall.
This/It was the first time that…过去完成It was the first time he had spoken in public.
This is the + 最高级 + N + that…现在完成This is the best book I have ever read.
状语从句时态三兄弟（复习）

① 主将从现：If it rains, we won’t go.
② 主情从现：If it rains, we may change plans.
③ 主祈从现：Let’s go if the weather is nice.

wrong_qs.note: this afternoon 安排 → 进行表将来
and 并列过去
the day after tomorrow → 将来
昨天+明天混合卷看标志
thought 原以为 → 过去相关

general_qs.stem: 看到 so far / recently / in the past few years，优先选？
general_qs.explain: 这些都是「算到现在」的时段标志。

general_qs.stem: This is the best film that I ________ (see).
general_qs.explain: 最高级 + that 从句 → 现在完成；常配 ever。

general_qs.stem: It was the first time that the little boy ________ (speak) in public.
general_qs.explain: 主句 was → 从句回退为过去完成 had spoken。

general_qs.stem: If it ________ (rain) tomorrow, we may stay at home.
general_qs.explain: 主情从现：从句用一般现在 rains。

nodes.title: ⑫ 综合坑：易混杀手组 + if 双身份 + 宾从三律（24/28 复习）
nodes.explain:
第 24、28 讲是综合复习卷：把前面所有时态坑 + 易混词混在一起打。本关把杀手组一次收干净。

卡 1 · if 的两张面孔
if 是谁长什么样从句时态
如果（条件状语从句）谈假设：If it is fine, we'll go主将从现：从句用一般现在表将来，禁 will
是否（宾语从句）跟在 wonder / know / ask 后正常时态：该将来就 will
27·T25 和 28·T22 是同一道题的两张皮：
We wonder if our parents will come...（wonder 后的 if＝是否 → 宾从，用 will）
If they come, we'll be glad.（这里的 if＝如果 → 条件句，用 come）
卡 2 · 宾语从句三律
律内容
① 陈述语序Could you tell me when you will leave（✗ when will you leave）
② 时态呼应主句过去 → 从句回移一级（will→would）；但客观真理永远一般现在：The sun rises in the east
③ Could 是礼貌Could you tell me...? 的从句不回移，该将来就 will
卡 3 · raise vs rise
词及物？意思记法
raise raised–raised✓ 及物举起；筹款；提高raise 有手（作用于别的东西）
rise rose–risen✗ 不及物升起；上涨rise 自己飞
有宾语 → raise；没宾语、主语自己升 → rise。不及物无被动：rise / appear / happen / take place。
卡 4 · has been to / in / gone to
短语意思人现在在哪
has been to去过（已回来）回来了
has been in一直在（常接 for）还在那儿
has gone to去了（还没回）在路上/在那儿
卡 5 · used to do vs be used to doing
短语to 是什么意思
used to do不定式 → 原形过去常常（现在不了）
be used to doing介词 → doing习惯于
卡 6 · open / close 词性

· open 可作形容词：be open＝开着/营业中（可接 for 12 hours）
· close 作动词：closes＝关门动作；is close＝亲近，不是关门

wrong_qs.note: 综合五：rise → rose（过去，不及物）
is open … closes（状态 + 动作）
rises … raise（太阳自己升 / 人举手帘）
客观真理 → rises
took place（无被动）
if 双身份：条件句 → come
for 时段 → has been in
has risen … appeared
There used to be
used to … is used to walking
if 双身份：is; will rain
陈述语序：when you will leave
is open … closes
raised（有宾语 $）

general_qs.stem: If it ________ (not rain) tomorrow, we will go camping.
general_qs.explain: if＝如果 → 主将从现，doesn't rain。

general_qs.stem: I don't know if it ________ (rain) tomorrow.
general_qs.explain: know 后的 if＝是否 → 宾从，该将来就 will rain。

general_qs.stem:
Could you tell me where ________?
A. does he live  B. he lives
general_qs.explain: 宾从用陈述语序；Could 是礼貌，不回移。

general_qs.stem:
The price of vegetables ________ a lot recently.
A. has risen  B. has raised  C. has been risen  D. rose
general_qs.explain: 价格自己涨 → rise；recently → 完成；无被动。

general_qs.stem:
—Where is Tom? —He ________ the library. He'll be back soon.
A. has been to  B. has gone to  C. has been in
general_qs.explain: 人还没回来 → has gone to。

general_qs.stem:
The bookstore ________ for 12 hours a day. It ________ at 10:00 p.m.
A. opens; closes  B. opens; is closed  C. is open; is close  D. is open; closes
general_qs.explain: 状态用 is open；每天关门动作用 closes（不是 is close）。

general_qs.stem:
There ________ a noisy factory here.
A. used to be  B. used to have  C. was used to be
general_qs.explain: There be 存在句 → used to be（不配 have）。

general_qs.stem: The teacher said light ________ (travel) faster than sound.
general_qs.explain: 宾从里的客观真理 → 永远一般现在 travels。
